prompt: we had a bad checkout hour. logs from the gateway, orders and payments are in logs/. the gateway has the status of each request and the other two log the same request id under their own field name. I need answer.json with: checkout_failures (POST /checkout that didn't return 200), how many of those were caused by a bank timeout in payments (payments_timeout, note payments sometimes retries and recovers, those don't count), a db error in orders (orders_db), a stock conflict (stock_conflict), and slowest_ok_checkout which is the request id of the slowest successful checkout
